---
title: "Pseudowords"
subtitle: "Non-words for the LexTALE-style test: how they were made, filtered, rated and chosen"
page-layout: full
toc: false

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import _lib as L
import itables
itables.init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=False, connected=True)

acc, rej = L.csv("pseudoslowa.csv"), L.csv("pseudoslowa_odrzucone.csv")
m7 = L.metrics("pseudoslowa_7")
n = lambda v: L.fmt(int(v))
sel = acc[acc["wybrane"] == True]
lex = m7.get("leksykon", {})
thr = m7.get("progi_oceny", {})
short = lambda m: str(m or "–").replace("claude-", "")
```

A pseudoword for a lexical-decision test must look and sound like a possible Polish word, must not exist, and must
not give itself away by its length, its ending or an odd letter pattern. This page shows what the pipeline produced:
`{python} n(len(sel))` recommended pseudowords for `{python} n(sel["szablon"].nunique())` of
`{python} n(m7.get("n_szablonow", 0))` templates, the `{python} n(len(acc))` strings that passed the filters, and the
`{python} n(len(rej))` rejected candidates with the reason for each. Nothing here has been judged by people yet.

**Templates** are real nouns and verbs in their base form, drawn from the two pools
(`{python} ", ".join(f"{v} from the {('general' if k == 'ogolna' else 'subject')} pool" for k, v in m7.get("szablony_wg_puli", {}).items())`),
so that pseudowords resemble the real items of the test in length and shape.

**Generators.** Five sources are compared; none replaces another.

| Generator | How it works |
|:---|:---|
| `wuggy_koncowka` | Wuggy (Polish orthographic module): same sub-syllabic segment lengths as the template, two thirds of the segments shared, similar transition frequencies; only strings that keep the template's final rime (the approach of Dołżycka et al. 2022) |
| `wuggy` | the same search, strings with a different ending |
| `unipseudo` | UniPseudo letter-trigram chain built from WorldLex-Polish nouns or verbs of the same length; generated independently, then paired with a template |
| `llm` | `{python} short(m7.get("model_generujacy"))`, given the template and the requirements |
| `imbir` | ready-made list of Imbir et al. (2015), items accepted by at least four of five judges, paired by length |

**Hard filters** reject a candidate if it exists (Morfeusz2, KWJP100, WorldLex, wordfreq, the corpus); if its
length, syllable count or ending differs from the template; if it contains a letter trigram, an onset, a coda or a
cluster found in fewer than `{python} n(lex.get("min_typow_ngramu", 0))` of the `{python} n(lex.get("lematy_kwjp", 0))`
lemmas of the reference lexicon; if it is one edit away from a frequent word (Zipf ≥
`{python} L.fmt(lex.get("prog_zipf"))`); if it sounds like an existing word; if it is an existing stem with a
productive prefix or suffix, or two words joined; if it has a vulgar association; or if it sounds like one of
`{python} n(lex.get("slowa_ua_ru", 0))` frequent Ukrainian and Russian words written in Polish spelling.

**Rating and choice.** For each template the pseudowords closest to it in OLD20 and bigram probability were rated by
`{python} short(m7.get("model_oceniajacy"))`: pronounceability (1–5), the real word it brings to mind and how
strongly (0–3), whether it exists, whether it is a foreign word, whether it is inappropriate. A pseudoword is
recommended (`wybrane`) if pronounceability is at least `{python} n(thr.get("min_wymawialnosc", 0))`, similarity at
most `{python} n(thr.get("max_podobienstwo", 0))`, and no flag is raised. The model rating stands in for human judges
at the selection stage only.

```{python}
rows = []
for m, d in m7.get("wg_metody", {}).items():
    rows.append((f"`{m}`", d.get("wygenerowane"), d.get("przyjete"), d.get("udzial_przyjetych"), d.get("oceniane"),
                 d.get("udzial_pozytywnych"), d.get("srednia_wymawialnosc"), d.get("srednie_podobienstwo"), d.get("wybrane")))
L.table(rows, ["Generator", "Generated", "Passed the filters", "… share", "Rated", "Rated positively, share",
               "Mean pronounceability (1–5)", "Mean similarity to a word (0–3)", "Recommended"])
```

A string produced by several generators is listed once, under the first of them in the order of the table above;
`metody_wszystkie` names all of them.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Recommended

`{python} n(len(sel))` pseudowords, up to `{python} n(sel.groupby("szablon").size().max() if len(sel) else 0)` per
template.

```{python}
L.source("pseudoslowa.csv")
cols = ["szablon", "pseudoslowo", "metoda", "pos", "pula_szablonu", "ocena_wymawialnosc", "ocena_skojarzenie", "ocena_podobienstwo",
        "old20", "old20_szablon", "bigram_lp", "bigram_lp_szablon", "n_sasiadow_1", "sasiedzi_1", "podobne_ua_ru", "dlugosc", "syl", "para_blokada"]
cols = [c for c in cols if c in sel.columns]
L.glossary(cols)
L.dt(sel[cols], page=50)
```

## All that passed the filters

```{python}
L.glossary(acc.columns)
L.dt(acc, page=50, hide=[c for c in ["relacja", "dlugosc_szablon", "syl_szablon", "para_blokada", "wuggy_pasmo", "unipseudo_algorytm",
                                     "unipseudo_modeli", "imbir_n_sedziow", "min_trigram_typow", "metody_wszystkie"] if c in acc.columns])
```

## Rejected

```{python}
L.source("pseudoslowa_odrzucone.csv")
why = {"znaki_spoza_alfabetu": "characters outside the alphabet", "istniejace_slowo": "existing word",
       "ksztalt_niezgodny_ze_wzorcem": "length, syllables or ending differ from the template",
       "za_blisko_wzorca": "one letter from the template", "ortotaktyka": "untypical letter pattern",
       "literowka_czestego_slowa": "one edit from a frequent word", "homofon": "sounds like an existing word",
       "przejrzysta_budowa": "existing stem with an affix, or a compound", "skojarzenie_wulgarne": "vulgar association",
       "slowo_ukrainskie_lub_rosyjskie": "Ukrainian or Russian word"}
ct = pd.crosstab(rej["powod_odrzucenia"], rej["metoda"])
ct["all"] = ct.sum(axis=1)
ct = ct.sort_values("all", ascending=False).reset_index()
ct["powod_odrzucenia"] = ct["powod_odrzucenia"].map(lambda x: f"{why.get(x, x)} (`{x}`)")
L.df_table(ct.rename(columns={"powod_odrzucenia": "Reason"}))
L.md("A candidate is counted under the first filter it fails. `wuggy` and `unipseudo` do not aim at the template's "
     "ending, so most of their candidates fail the shape filter by design.")
keep = [c for c in ["szablon", "pseudoslowo", "metoda", "powod_odrzucenia", "szczegol", "pos", "pula_szablonu", "dlugosc"] if c in rej.columns]
L.glossary(keep)
L.dt(rej[keep], page=50)
```

## Templates against pseudowords

Mean and standard deviation of six features for the templates, for all pseudowords that passed the filters and for
the recommended list. The last column is the standardised mean difference from the templates; values near 0 mean
that a pupil cannot tell words from pseudowords by that feature alone.

```{python}
d = L.csv("pseudoslowa_rozklady.csv")
grp = {"szablony": "templates", "pseudoslowa_przyjete": "passed the filters", "pseudoslowa_wybrane": "recommended"}
feat = {"dlugosc": "length in letters", "syl": "syllables", "zbitka": "longest consonant run", "diakryty": "diacritic letters",
        "old20": "OLD20", "bigram_lp": "mean log bigram probability"}
L.source("pseudoslowa_rozklady.csv")
L.table([(feat.get(r.cecha, r.cecha), grp.get(r.grupa, r.grupa), r.n, r.srednia, r.odch_std, r.smd_wzgledem_szablonow)
         for r in d.sort_values(["cecha", "grupa"], ascending=[True, False]).itertuples()],
        ["Feature", "Group", "n", "Mean", "SD", "Standardised difference from templates"], "llrrrr")
by = acc.groupby("metoda")[["dlugosc", "syl", "zbitka", "diakryty", "old20", "bigram_lp", "n_sasiadow_1"]].mean().round(3).reset_index()
L.md("Means by generator, all strings that passed the filters:")
L.df_table(by)
L.source("pseudoslowa_szablony.csv")
```
